newsitem.title: POLAND: Zloty fixed stronger at 2.49 pct from parity rate.
newsitem.headline: Zloty fixed stronger at 2.49 pct from parity rate.

text.p: The National Bank of Poland fixed the zloty at 3.1620 to the dollar, down from 3.1480 on Friday, and at 1.8255 to the mark, up from 1.8345, the NBP said.
The central bank fixed the zloty at an average of 2.49 percent from the weighted dollar and mark parity rates, stronger than Friday's 2.47 percent fix.
It was at 2.49 percent from the floating parity rate, which changes along with changes in the dollar/mark rate on world markets, against 2.46 percent on Friday.
